• **Article 30 of the Indian Constitution **is one of many provisions that ensure that minority rights are preserved.
 
• It is listed under **Part III of the Indian Constitution **which sheds light on the fundamental rights granted to Indian citizens regardless of caste, religion, and gender.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 28** tells us about the Right to follow religious instruction or religious worship in certain educational establishments.
 
• **Article 17** is about the Abolition of Untouchability.
 
• **Article 32** focuses on the rights of constitutional remedies.

questions.question: Who among the following made the first observation on Platinum as a catalyst and discovered similar triads of elements that led to the development of the Periodic Table of elements?
questions.solution:
__**Johann Wolfgang Dobereiner**__ made his first observation as a catalyst on Platinum and discovered similar triads of elements which led to the creation of the Periodic Table of Elements.

 
• He was a **German chemist** best known for his work, which foreshadowed the periodic rule for chemical elements, and for inventing the **Döbereiner's first lighter.**
 
• **Döbereiner** is also known for his discovery of the furfural, for his work on using platinum as a catalyst.
 
• **Dmitri Mendeleev **produces a farsighted interpretation of the periodic element table.
 
• **Hans Christian Oersted **discovered that electric currents produce magnetic fields, which was the first relation between magnetism and electricity.
 
• **Michael Faraday **contributed to the **study of electromagnetism and electrochemistry.**

questions.question: The Mughal Sarai Railway Station has been renamed after ______.
questions.solution:
**The Mughal Sarai Railway Station **has been renamed after __**Deen Dayal Upadhyaya.**__

 
• **Pt. Deen Dayal Upadhyaya **junction located in the state of** Uttar Pradesh.**
 
• The station has the** biggest Asian railroad marshalling yard.**
 
• The largest **Indian Railways wagon repair** workshop is located at Mughalsarai.
 
• In 2017, the Indian government approved a fresh proposal to rename the station, forwarded by the **Yogi Adityanath-led government.**
 
• In August 2018, the station was officially renamed to the **Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyaya junction.**
